>
> "用 antigravity 识别这张图片：`C:\pr"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ojects\screenshots\ui.png`""},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Images inside the session workspace work directly; images elsewhere need the
directory in the tool's"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" `dirs` parameter (or the `addDirs` config)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Tasks targeting files **outside** the session workspace need the target
directory: the tool takes "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"a `dirs` parameter (the model passes it when you
give it the path).
- **Long tasks**: the model uses"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" `background: true` for long jobs — it keeps
you posted on live progress and reports the final resul"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"t when done.
- **Continue a task**: tell the model to continue using the `task` key from a
previous "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"call.
- **Find a task again**: `antigravity_tasks` lists running and recent
finished tasks — task ke"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ys are recorded in

always be "},{"id":"p24s7","text":"recovered for follow-up.
- **Stop a task**: `antigravity_cancel` with the running task's key stops i"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"t
(also possible via `job_kill` for background jobs)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"All fields are optional; sane defaults are shown. Configure through the
plugin's settings section (e"},{"id":"p26s2","text":".g. `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`):"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `providerName` | `antigravity` | registry name on `ctx.subagents` |
| `toolName` | `antigravity` |"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" new-task tool name |
| `followupToolName` | `antigravity_followup` | follow-up tool name |
| `login"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ToolName` | `antigravity_login` | login-window tool name |
| `tasksToolName` | `antigravity_tasks` |"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" tasks-listing tool name |
| `cancelToolName` | `antigravity_cancel` | cancel-running-task tool name"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" |
| `command` | `agy` | executable (PATH name or absolute path) |
| `model` | `''` | `--model <slug"},{"id":"p29s6","text":">` (see `agy models`); empty = agy default |
| `effort` | `''` | `--effort low\|medium\|high`; empty"},{"id":"p29s7","text":" = omit |
| `agent` | `''` | `--agent <name>`; empty = omit |
| `printTimeoutMs` | `300000` | foregr"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ound run ceiling (`--print-timeout`) |
| `backgroundTimeoutMs` | `3600000` | background run ceiling "},{"id":"p29s9","text":"(1 h) |
| `watchdogMarginMs` | `60000` | force-kill margin after the ceiling if agy hangs |
| `skipP"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"ermissions` | `true` | `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (auto-approve agy tool calls) |
| `sandbox` "},{"id":"p29s11","text":"| `false` | `--sandbox` (agy terminal-sandbox restrictions) |
| `avoidBrowser` | `true` | append a n"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"ote telling agy NOT to use headless browser tools (they can hang on some machines) |
| `avoidLargeRe"},{"id":"p29s13","text":"ads` | `true` | append a note telling agy to inspect files > 1 MB via grep/sed instead of its read t"},{"id":"p29s14","text":"ool (4 MB cap) |
| `outputFormat` | `json` | wire format (`json` or `text`); background prefers `str"},{"id":"p29s15","text":"eam-json` automatically |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How it works (short version)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Each task spawns a fresh `agy -p <task>` process in the session workspace
and returns the final answ"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"er. Runs use `--output-format json`, whose reply
carries agy's `conversation_id`; the plugin records"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" it in a durable registry
(`~/.dsh/agy-conversations.json`), and `antigravity_followup` resumes the
"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"same conversation via `--conversation <id>`. Background runs use
`stream-json` for live progress and"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" register with DSH's jobs system
(`job_output` / `job_kill`). A local watchdog terminates hung runs,"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" and all
timeouts interrupt: nothing ever waits forever."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`antigravity_tasks` surfaces the durable registry (restart-safe) plus live
in-flight runs, and `anti"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"gravity_cancel` stops a running one. The registry
self-heals: a corrupted file is backed up once (`*"},{"id":"p32s3","text":".corrupt`) and reset
instead of being silently overwritten, and all registry writes are
serialized, "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"so concurrent runs never lose each other's records."}],"truncated":true}
